verdict.rationale: Loops lets you create and update workflow graphs from code, including adding, branching, editing and deleting nodes, and only published workflows are started by events. That means you could keep definitions in your own source control and gate changes behind publishing, and draft campaigns can be reviewed in the dashboard before sending. Nothing shows built-in versioning, change review, or rollback for automations, so this is a do-it-yourself workaround rather than a native feature. Missing for 10: native workflow version history, a diff/review step for workflow changes, one-click rollback to a prior version, and independent corroboration.
